page_about_content_p1: Zirkus Mond, meeting point of the Berlin artist scene, venue for circus, theater, dance & concerts, emerged in 2018 from the activities of the Children of the Moon, a fluid collective of international artists, dancers & performers who had been operating in Berlin's cultural underground for over 10 years, periodically filling vacant buildings, wastelands, or public spaces with love and life. Now, in the celestial habitat Zirkus Mond, there are 2 self-produced shows and 2 guest events every month, with each show being unique due to changing artists and concepts.
page_about_content_p2: The gates of our circus tent are open to all who wish to visit, perform in, and help shape a place of community, creativity, and love of life.
page_about_content_p3: Zirkus Mond is a safe space for all people. Antisocial behavior of any kind will not be tolerated.
page_about_open_source_content: Zirkusmond is not just a stage, it is also code: the software behind Zirkus Mond is public on GitHub. If you would like to tinker with the website, fix bugs, share ideas, or sprinkle in some digital glitter, we would love your contribution.
